```{=html}
<script>
(() => {
  function initialize() {
    const slider = document.querySelector(".project-slider");
    if (!slider || slider.dataset.initialized) return;
    const track = slider.querySelector(".project-track");
    if (!track) return;
    const cards = [...track.querySelectorAll(".project-story")];
    const previous = slider.querySelector(".project-arrow-left");
    const next = slider.querySelector(".project-arrow-right");
    const count = document.getElementById("project-count");
    if (!cards.length || !previous || !next) return;
    slider.dataset.initialized = "true";
    let targetIndex = 0;
    let moving = false;
    let settleTimer;
    function position(index) {
      return cards[index].getBoundingClientRect().left
        - track.getBoundingClientRect().left
        - track.clientLeft
        + track.scrollLeft;
    }
    function nearestIndex() {
      return cards.reduce((closest, card, index) =>
        Math.abs(position(index) - track.scrollLeft) <
        Math.abs(position(closest) - track.scrollLeft)
          ? index : closest, 0);
    }
    function update(index) {
      const first = index === 0;
      const last = index === cards.length - 1;
      if (first && document.activeElement === previous) {
        next.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      }
      if (last && document.activeElement === next) {
        previous.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      }
      previous.hidden = first;
      next.hidden = last;
      if (count) {
        count.textContent = `${index + 1} / ${cards.length}`;
      }
    }
    function settle() {
      moving = false;
      targetIndex = nearestIndex();
      update(targetIndex);
    }
    function move(direction) {
      if (!moving) targetIndex = nearestIndex();
      targetIndex = Math.max(
        0,
        Math.min(cards.length - 1, targetIndex + direction)
      );
      moving = true;
      update(targetIndex);
      track.scrollTo({
        left: position(targetIndex),
        behavior: matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches
          ? "auto" : "smooth"
      });
      clearTimeout(settleTimer);
      settleTimer = setTimeout(settle, 250);
    }
    previous.addEventListener("click", () => move(-1));
    next.addEventListener("click", () => move(1));
    track.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
      if (!moving) update(nearestIndex());
      clearTimeout(settleTimer);
      settleTimer = setTimeout(settle, 150);
    }, { passive: true });
    track.addEventListener("pointerdown", () => {
      moving = false;
    }, { passive: true });
    track.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
      if (event.target !== track) return;
      if (event.key === "ArrowLeft" || event.key === "ArrowRight") {
        event.preventDefault();
        move(event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -1 : 1);
      }
    });
    window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
      track.scrollTo({
        left: position(targetIndex),
        behavior: "instant"
      });
      settle();
    });
    settle();
  }
  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initialize, {
      once: true
    });
  } else {
    initialize();
  }
})();
</script>
```
